theory_mapping: Native masses: fold_attention computes overlap-plus-EPS native attention and sums it within valid-order alternating folds. The common E0 normalization cancels.
Donor construction: measured_attention computes E0, log(E0), A_D=U_D-f_D S_D, N_D and the normalized matrix exponential with ordinary autograd lineage.
Recipient routing: fold_attention selects donor=1-recipient for cross_fold and donor=recipient for self_fold, then normalizes recipient weights and multiplies by the recipient's native mass.
Readout: fold_attention aggregates every valid token utility; CrossFoldUtilityHead adds only the original bias.
Equations (2)/(3): canary compares right finite-difference score derivatives with explicit logarithmic-mean bilinear/quadratic expressions for aligned and opposing witnesses.
Equation (4): canary checks zero diagonal cross blocks, symmetry, signed eigenvalue pairing, self positive semidefiniteness and an autograd-versus-finite-difference direction.
Equation (1): exhaustive bounded sign distributions test zero independent-fold noise readout and positive/negative correlated failure witnesses.
fidelity_gaps: The Jacobian test does not directly compare every entry against the analytic B_t/logarithmic-mean formula in Equation (4), nor explicitly verify the self-fold Gram entries. Structural and directional checks provide weaker coverage.
Parameter isolation checks state-dictionary keys and total parameter count, not an explicit comparison of every named parameter shape and trainability flag.
Numerical execution, full-value trace persistence and reader readiness remain unestablished; exposed diagnostic tensors are not a completed trace implementation.
risks: No definite equation-mapping defect is apparent in the supplied source. This is static review, not execution or independent verification of the supplied hashes.

Interspersed masks, all 40 classes including null, and singleton fallback are handled faithfully. Cross-fold is mathematically native through three tokens; self-fold can redistribute at three. Both conditions execute two donor effects whenever both folds are nonempty.

Native masses and donor effects retain gradients. Utility and normalized-state directional checks are meaningful, but finite parameter gradients alone do not prove every parameter pathway is numerically correct.

Float64 matrix-exponential behavior, tolerances, runtime and resource fit remain untested. Extremely large finite utilities can overflow intermediate arithmetic and cause deliberate fail-closed rejection rather than a finite result.

The parent source uses one synchronous child launch, explicit argv/cwd, inherited environment with thread limits, report validation and marker-last publication. Supplied stub fixtures support failure/publication behavior, not execution of the scientific child or scheduler admission.

CPU, RAM and disk limits and single-attempt admission are not fully enforced by this script; they depend on the external scheduler and immutable attempt setup. The existing work-directory guard prevents ordinary same-attempt replay.
The source manifest does not transitively hash every imported module, including the inherited FrozenFeatureHead implementation. The stated immutable clean-worktree binding remains important.

The parent validates required report fields but does not enforce an exact report-key whitelist or compare the reported seed/environment against the design. The frozen child supplies them correctly in the reviewed path.

Failure logs and command evidence are retained outside the publication directory; RUN_COMPLETE authenticates only compact-report.json. Full artifact custody and independent post-execution observation remain external requirements.
Synthetic independence is stipulated, not inferred for contextual NLP errors. No unbiased training-gradient, task-benefit, novelty or formal-readiness conclusion follows.
